title: How to Set Up Claude Cowork in 5 Minutes
description:
If you've been hearing about Claude Cowork but haven't set it up yet, here's how.
Download the desktop app from claude.com. Works on Mac and Windows.
Sign in with a Pro account ($20/month). Cowork requires a paid plan.
Create your first project, point it at a folder, and add instructions.
Connect your Google or Microsoft account for email and file access.
Five minutes from start to working AI assistant.

Link: https://claude.com
channel_name: Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies
